break.why: Why should I take a break?
break.whyExplanation1: Digital technology eliminates friction, allowing you to quickly move between infinite tasks. This property makes it both useful and easy to misuse.
break.whyExplanation2: By restoring a small amount of friction, breaks give you space to reflect and make decisions.
